ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals. We started out in 2015 as ING’s software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate in Bucharest. Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data Management, Touchpoint Channels & Integration, Core Banking, and Global Products. We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged. For us, impact isnt a perk. Its the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?

Heres a sneak peak of what our colleagues say about working within ING Hubs Romania:At ING, were building the solutions of tomorrow, today | 80% of our colleagues in Romania agreeThe MissionIn your role you will support the Global Data Products strategy in achieving well-governed solutions that ensure data availability, common understanding of business terms, data quality, and traceable and controlled data.In this role, you will be instrumental in bridging business needs and data delivery by translating requirements into clear data logic, specifications, metadata, and validation criteria. Your work will ensure that data is accessible, well understood, traceable, controlled, and regulatory compliant, ultimately enabling trusted analytics insights that support business decisions and contribute to strategic direction.Your day to dayIn this role you will:o translate the business requirements in collaboration with the international stakeholders focusing on:o creating re-usable solutions promoting standardization, scalability, and efficiencyo data modelling and data exposure to the end userso prepare definitions for business terms, based on existing ING data catalogues including the requirements on data quality, data lineage, data privacy and data securityo create analysis deliverables such as workflow diagrams, data models and functional/technical documentationo collaborate closely with architects to ensure new solutions are designed and implemented in alignment with the target architecture and strategic data landscapeo Support with migration of business terms to the new catalogue/systemo support for solving production incidents in reference to the mapping of the Business Termso design and execute end-to-end functional test cases, ensuring that outputs match business requirements before go-liveo manage stakeholder expectations, support planning together with the team and take ownership of your deliverableso show availability and willingness to help otherso proactively identify opportunities to improve data quality, documentation, governance practices and team delivery effectivenesso lead by example in navigating complex challenges, promoting analytical thinking and pragmatic problem-solving approachesWhat youll bring to the teamMandatory:o Have experience in Data Management and knowledge of Data Solutions (E.g. Data Warehousing, Data Catalogue, Data Modelling, Data Lineage),o Have experience in banking / regulatory reporting / credit risk domainso Have excellent stakeholder management skills,o Able to proactively and independently identify problems, analyze key information and make connections, in order to bring solutions to senior management,o have excellent communication skills, written and verbal in English (C1),o familiar with Agile environment, and you know how to make it a real part of your job,o have multicultural mind-set and a highly customer-focused outlook.Nice to have:o having experience working in a large (international) organization spanning multiple segments and locations, dealing with global operating models and deployment across countries and/or hubs,o experience with banking products, processes, and servicesEducation: master or bachelors degree (IT, Engineering, Mathematics or Economics/Business)If you want to deep dive into the processing of personal data conducted by ING Hubs Romania during the recruitment process and your rights related to it, read the privacy notices on our website (make sure to scroll until you reach the Data Protection section/ Candidates tab).
